title: Fiscora
summary: Finance website and dashboard for small businesses. Avora Digital's own product: designed, built and run in-house.

caseStudy.overview: Fiscora is a finance website and dashboard for small businesses. It is Avora Digital's own product: designed, built and run in-house, and live at getfiscora.com.
caseStudy.challenge: Small business owners see their sales, not their real profit. Courier charges, returns, payment fees, ads and tax eat the margin, and nobody adds them up.
caseStudy.solution: We built two layers. Free calculators answer one question each, in the visitor's language. The finance dashboard brings sales and costs together, so owners can see profit and loss, cash flow and profit by product, channel, city and courier, with alerts when something changes and planning tools to look ahead.
features: 20 free financial calculators in 10 languages, including Urdu and Arabic (right to left)
A finance dashboard: profit and loss, cash flow, expense analysis, receivables, profit by product, channel, city and courier, and alerts
Planning tools: a 3-scenario profit forecast, a 13-week cash forecast and budgets
Import from Shopify or any CSV file, an Orders API for custom websites, Excel export and a live Google Sheets link
41 currencies with VAT, GST or sales tax; up to 3 businesses and a team of 3 per business
Privacy by design: Google sign-in, no customer contact details stored, and data deleted only when the user deletes it
Built with Next.js, Cloudflare Pages and Workers, and Cloudflare D1; payments through Paddle as merchant of record
Quality: 177 automated calculator tests, automated end-to-end tests of the dashboard, and every page checked in all 10 languages on phone and desktop
caseStudy.status: Live at getfiscora.com. Payments through Paddle as merchant of record: checkout is being set up.

title: Peony
summary: A concept skincare store for the Pakistani market: 19 products across five ranges, a scroll-driven hero and a checkout built around cash on delivery.
imageAlt: Peony concept skincare store: "Bloom, slowly." headline next to a rose cream jar

caseStudy.overview: Peony is a concept build: a complete skincare store for a fictional Pakistani brand, designed and developed by Avora Digital to show how we would build a premium beauty store for this market. It is not a commissioned client project.
caseStudy.challenge: Beauty shoppers in Pakistan judge a new brand on two things before they buy: does it feel premium enough to trust with their skin, and can they pay safely. Most local stores either look like a template or hide delivery, payment and exchange details until checkout.
caseStudy.solution: We kept the range short and the store calm: a scroll-driven hero, a three-step ritual (cleanse, hydrate, renew) that tells shoppers where to start, and product cards that show size, price and texture at a glance. Trust details that Pakistani shoppers look for, such as cash on delivery, phone confirmation, delivery threshold and exchange policy, sit on every page instead of in the footer only.
features: 19 products across five ranges: skin, lips, eyes, body, and tools and sets
Scroll-driven hero that opens as the visitor scrolls
Product cards with size, price in PKR, badges and a texture view on hover
Quick add to bag from the shop page
A three-step ritual that guides first-time shoppers
Payment options built for Pakistan: cash on delivery, JazzCash, Easypaisa and bank transfer
Delivery, exchange and order confirmation details on every page, plus WhatsApp support
caseStudy.status: Live as a concept demo. The brand and products are fictional.
